purpose: Same fixed SGF case, genuine current-plus-previous six-frame output and portable vector layout anchors.

semantics.figure_type: Conceptual source-dependency overview and authentic qualitative results, not a fixed-clean paired reconstruction
semantics.shared_clean_role: The shared operator path illustrates identical policies and tensor roles; the actual free trajectories each generate their own clean latents.
semantics.denoising_source_view: Nonrecent and two Recent history cards remain fully visible. Current is a flat 5x3 grid filled only with illustrative noise, with no scene or person underneath. Denoising produces the clean latent; committing Current cards use the same full-cell flat grid without noise. Grid divisions are symbolic, not latent frames or model layers. Scene-card counts are role-level illustrations, not physical-cache frame counts.
semantics.recent_committing: immediately preceding block3 + current 3 = 6 latent frames
semantics.slabs: Slab glyphs outside the filmstrip indicate tensor/block roles; their offsets do not assert the number of Transformer layers, latent frames, tensor channels or physical-cache frames. Inline Current instead uses a flat grid. Clean latents are not per-layer KV.
semantics.persistent_sequence: Distinct later blocks construct their own KV. Arrows denote further autoregressive generation, not direct KV decoding or copying the first KV.
semantics.gray_marks: Schematic source-dependent influence carried into subsequent KV; shape, area, number and density are not quantitative. Fragmentation/spatial spread is not a measured monotone increase or acceleration of drift.
semantics.unmarked_recent: Gridded recent-context glyphs without gray patches omit the depicted direct Nonrecent dependency; they do not imply empty KV, zero values, zero indirect historical dependence or zero total drift.
semantics.no_lag_curve: No b+1/b+3, numeric lag, measured KV norm or monotone growth/decay series is drawn.
semantics.film_triangles: Small rightward triangles mark temporal direction along the filmstrip, not an attention mask or a propagation wedge.
semantics.photos: Same fixed prompt 0 and initial-noise seed 0 at 238 s; native 12 versus actual SGF_W6. Original baseline PNG bytes are preserved. The SGF_W6 display PNG is decoded from the existing video and resized to 416x240. Both use the same [90,0,326,240] crop; no scene retouching or inpainting.
semantics.lower_selection: Only the newest Recent block and Current are directly visible; nonrecent and older recent cards remain stored but are masked from committing.
